description: This file defines an abstract generic class ContentFieldDisplayDriver<TField> that extends DisplayDriverBase and implements IContentFieldDisplayDriver. It manages display, editing, and updating of content fields within OrchardCore CMS, including shape generation and alternate shape naming conventions.

classes.name: ContentFieldDisplayDriver`1
classes.description: An abstract class for managing display and editing of content fields in OrchardCore, handling shape creation and alternate naming conventions based on content type, part, and field definitions.

methods.name: Factory
methods.description: Overrides the base Factory method to generate shapes with appropriate differentiators and alternates based on content part and field definitions.

methods.name: BuildDisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display shape for a content field asynchronously if the field type matches.

methods.name: BuildEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content field asynchronously if the field type matches.

methods.name: UpdateEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the content field asynchronously based on user input if the field type matches.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Virtual method to generate display result for a field, can be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Virtual method to generate edit shape for a field, can be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Virtual method to handle updating a field asynchronously, can be overridden.

methods.name: GetEditorShapeType
methods.description: Generates shape type string for editor shapes based on optional editor name.

methods.name: GetDisplayShapeType
methods.description: Generates shape type string for display shapes based on display mode.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Constructs the HTML field prefix based on content type part and field definitions.
